messages.subject: fileInput, reload and defaults
parts:
I am using a "fileInput" element in the UI.

When I browse for a file and load it, the name of the file appears next to the "Browse" button.

If I then reload the web page, the name of the previous file loaded is still there.
Is it cached?
Is there a way initialize the fileInput display with a default file and name?

messages.author: b5c4e9bc26eb2af7
messages.subject: Re: fileInput, reload and defaults
parts:
Firefox 24.4

Shiny Version: 0.8.0

Single app launch with runApp

No ... but here is a simple example where after using the fileInput button the name of the file remains next to the button after reloading (even after restarting runApp).

## ui.R ##
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel("Hello Shiny!"),

    sidebarPanel(
                  fileInput("myName",label="Load Database",multiple=F)
    ),

    # Show a plot
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("myPlot")
    )

))

## server.R ##
library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

     myFile = reactive({
      dnm = input$myName$name
      print(input$myName)
      if(is.null(dnm))return(NULL)
      dnm
    })

  output$myPlot <- renderPlot({
      plot(0,1,main=myFile())
  })
})
